source.rationale: A positional reply arriving on a turn whose result set came back EMPTY must not enter the pick lane at all. Entering it would emit 'There are only 0 promotions in that list, please reply with a number between 1 and 0' — a sentence that is both nonsense and a different situation from the one the customer is in. The zero-answer turn falls through untouched and the not-found path keeps ownership.
